run_benchmark_mock: run the benchmark_mock script to measure proxy latency and throughput against a target URL
run_send_request: run a single async POST request with timing and return elapsed milliseconds on success
run_run_benchmark: run a concurrent benchmark sending N requests with configurable concurrency and collect latency percentiles
run_print_run_results: run print_run_results to display a single benchmark run summary with latency and throughput stats
run_print_aggregate: run print_aggregate to display combined statistics and run-to-run variance across multiple benchmark runs
